adds.text: Erik and Hank train together on Charles's team to stop Shaw, but Erik talks Raven out of the cure Hank makes. At Cuba Erik breaks away and leaves, while Hank stays with Charles.

adds.evidence: Lehnsherr and Xavier meet McCoy at Division X and recruit with Cerebro; Raven, persuaded by Lehnsherr, refuses McCoy's cure; Lehnsherr parts ways with Xavier after Cuba while McCoy returns to the mansion.

adds.title: The Marvels
adds.text: Fury stays in contact with Carol as she checks the broken jump point, and on S.A.B.E.R. he shows her his plan to evacuate the crew inside Goose's kittens.

adds.evidence: Danvers talks with Fury from MB-418 about the jump point; later Fury explains the Flerken evacuation plan to Captain Marvel on S.A.B.E.R.

adds.title: The Marvels
adds.text: Fury looks after Goose on S.A.B.E.R. while the Marvels are away, and when she gives birth he uses her kittens to swallow the crew and evacuate the station.

adds.evidence: Goose stays with Fury, who brings her to the S.A.B.E.R. station; her litter swallows the personnel for the evacuation Fury plans.
